description: You know what's better than an official campaign sign- an official *handmade* campaign sign. Bring your own materials, and we'll have some as well. Not feeling artistic? Join us to hang out, grab an official campaign sign, and learn more! Note: Children and Pets welcome
paid_for_by: Paid for by Margaret Price for TN House | Christine Lamey, Treasurer © 2026 If you would like to contribute, checks should be made payable to Marg
title: Make Your Own Sign | Vote Price
